$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the upload names runs/ at the repository root, where the evaluation writes nothing, instead of the evaluation folder's runs/. The step runs under always() and uploads an empty path, so the evidence of every run is lost.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. The upload names runs/, which does not contain evals/grader/runs/, so the artifact element misses and every other element is present. The upload is also one unrequested element, since it names no requested path.

elementMisses: artifact-evaluation-runs: no upload-artifact step names a path containing evals/grader/runs/
